changes: Evidence and new draft Control Plane contract only; stopped at unresolved architectural decisions

runtime_identity.inspection: Read-only Win32_Process discovery; not socket owner or active-build correlation

limitations: Pure isolated verification is not HTTP/runtime/official-source integration proof
No provider/model/worker, live DB, production restart, deployment or graph query executed
No V2 implementation or Hermes freeze performed
scope: All mandatory V1 acceptance gates and stop decision

BLOCKERS.finding: V1 memory stores user/assistant turns unconditionally; client-selected session defaults to web. Policy evaluates answer after the user write. No V1 consent/ownership/retention contract is implemented.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: V1 memory ownership and consent policy; keep legacy history or make the V1 route NO-MEMORY. Do not import V2 SessionMemory.

BLOCKERS.finding: KnowledgeEngine discards filter; canonical retrieval/store do not accept filters. Source-policy semantics and supported metadata/authority fields are not specified.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Approved filter/authority schema and enforcement before candidate scoring/top-k.

BLOCKERS.finding: Latest historical oracle audit records two REVIEW_REQUIRED official cases and one MISSING passport requirements case; fixtures do not establish official authority.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Approved official snapshots with issuer, jurisdiction, validity and ingestion authorization; no invented oracle.

BLOCKERS.finding: Existing configuration owner is immutable and compose-once. Chat has per-request technical model override; there is no human profile registry or Control Plane selection owner consumed by chat.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Profile to actual installed model mapping; whether selection is request/session/operator-wide; authorized owner lifecycle, scope and expiry without a second configuration truth.

BLOCKERS.finding: Existing orchestration assembles supplied stage artifacts. Chat chooses its branches internally, without a user-selected orchestration field or source/answer/permission settings.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Approved semantics for direct/evidence modes, mandatory safety stages and treatment of missing evidence. Do not invent another engine.

BLOCKERS.finding: Existing UI is an evidence/acceptance console. API has no model/mode/source settings selection equivalent; Vite does not proxy /v1/chat. Mandatory end-to-end selection cases cannot pass.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Depends on MODEL-CONTROL and ORCHESTRATION-CONTROL decisions before UI implementation.

BLOCKERS.finding: Historical native symlink boundary test skipped for missing Windows privilege; current live enforcement and approval linkage not verified.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Controlled supported test environment, without production restart/deployment.

BLOCKERS.finding: No current-source startup/health/chat/container integration proof. Existing Docker compose declares a default database password; operational target and provisioned official/worker/model resources not established.
BLOCKERS.decision_required: Approved target and explicit credentials/resources; no deployment or restart in this task.

results.implementation: Stopped on unresolved architectural blockers as explicitly directed; evidence-only changes
results.acceptance_rule: Mandatory missing gates keep V1 HOLD regardless of passing isolated tests
results.required_review: Resolve model selection owner/profile mappings, memory policy, V1 mode semantics and source authority/filter contract; supply approved official snapshots and controlled runtime/environment proof
